turn: The session listing page is now paginated. I added a `paginate(rows, page = 1, perPage = 20)` helper in `src/sessions/paginate.js`. It returns the items for the requested page along with the current page number and the total page count. I checked it by reading through the slice and page-count arithmetic for a few cases: the first page, a partial last page, and an empty list. I didn't run an automated test suite for this step, so the checking was by reasoning rather than execution. While in there I also made one small unplanned fix in the same commit: I corrected an inconsistent import path for a shared date-formatting helper that the listing code pulled in. Next I'll start on "Cache for session listings".

sidefix.title: Fix inconsistent date helper import
sidefix.what: Corrected an inconsistent import path for the shared date-formatting helper used by the session listing code.
